arguments.text: 8 km, 1250 m legs out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) keep the pod honest: compare pod shaft power vs heart rate and vs boat-model power each leg (pod drift -> set pod_gain); (2) watch local push for drag/weed (pacer has clear_rudder too); (3) check course length / radio messages, correct set_race_distance; (4) reassure if paddler talks. Check legs() each wake-up from leg 2 on. Baseline: early ratio boat/shaft power ~0.66-0.71 (CP 109/165).

arguments.text: t865: CURRENT confirmed: ~0.27 m/s pushing south since ~t660 (flips sign at turn 2). Pod honest. Boat-model numbers (power_w, reserve_left_pct, fade_pct) are skewed by it until push_along catches up: expect false fade/rate_down on northbound legs. Priced current-aware pacing (+6% up / -7% down): gains only ~1 s per leg pair, not worth reserve risk. Finish idea: if pod reserve <40% at ~800 m to go (pacer finish rule will not fire), spend it with a piece, mostly on the last (northbound, into current) leg.

Without the fix the pod reserve would falsely refill and the pacer finish rule could push an empty paddler.
